subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which linked PR should become the canonical fix path for the macOS dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but several open PRs target overlapping parts of the same root cause; choosing the landing candidate and closing duplicates is a maintainer coordination decision.

options.title: Review and land the strongest macOS fallback PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate if maintainer review confirms its current-head real macOS proof and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Choose another linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use a different open linked PR if it provides cleaner native app behavior, stronger real proof, or a better owner-boundary fix.

options.title: Ask for a replacement only if candidates stall
options.body: Keep this issue open and request a narrow replacement only if the existing linked PRs cannot be brought to a landable state.

recommendation.title: Review and land the strongest macOS fallback PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 as the leading candidate if maintainer review confirms its current-head real macOS proof and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical fix lands in the native macOS dashboard/gateway endpoint surface where steipete has the strongest recent history.
